_doc: Shared dev stacks, used through hooks/stacks.py. Copy to $CLUPAI_HOME/stacks.json or run `stacks.py add NAME --dir DIR`. runtime: docker-desktop or orbstack. The reaper stops a stack nobody has leased for grace_min minutes. devices: shared simulators/emulators for `stacks.py up NAME`; kind ios needs `device` (an Xcode simulator name), kind android needs `avd` (an AVD you created).

android-lite.note: Android test image (ATD): about half the memory of a full image. Use by default.

android.note: Full Android image. Use only when you need screenshots or Play services.
